title: Depth-zero circuits are literals
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb N$ and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit tree on $m$ variables. If $C$ has depth $0$, then there is a literal $\ell$ such that $C$ is the circuit consisting of that single literal.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean circuit tree C on m variables
replaced:
Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $m$ variables whose depth is $0$. Then $c$ is a leaf:
there exists a literal $l$ such that $c$ is the single-literal circuit built from $l$.
